scripts.build:chrome: node scripts/build-icons.mjs && tsc -b && vite build && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts
scripts.build:firefox: tsc -b && vite build --mode firefox && vite build --config vite.content.config.ts --mode firefox
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:chrome && rm -f moodle-archive-chrome.zip && cd dist-chrome && zip -r -X ../moodle-archive-chrome.zip . -x '.*' && cd ..
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && rm -f moodle-archive-firefox.zip && cd dist-firefox && zip -r -X ../moodle-archive-firefox.zip . -x '.*' && cd ..
